paragraphs: Freshpet, Inc. ("Freshpet," the "Company," "we" or "our") is disrupting the over $56.0 billion United States pet food industry by driving consumers to reassess conventional dog and cat food offerings that have remained essentially unchanged for decades. We position our brand to benefit from mainstream trends of growing pet humanization and consumer focus on health and wellness. We price our products to be accessible to the average consumer, providing us with broad demographic appeal and allowing us to penetrate multiple classes of retail, including grocery, mass, international, digital, pet specialty, and club. We have successfully expanded our network of Freshpet Fridges within leading blue-chip retail chains. The strength of our business model extends to our customers, who we believe find that Freshpet grows their pet category sales, drives higher traffic, increases shopper frequency and delivers category leading margins. As of December 31, 2025, our household penetration within the United States was approximately 15.2 million households. Additionally, we believe that there are opportunities to expand our network into international markets as demonstrated by our initiatives in the U.K. market.

We primarily compete in the United States dog and cat food market. The pet food market has historically been resilient as consumers continue to spend on their pets even during economic downturns, and we believe pet food spending in North America will increase long-term.
We believe the following trends will drive growth in our industry:

Pet ownership. There are currently approximately 98 million dog or cat food buying households in the United States, meaning that approximately 73% of total households are buying dog and/or cat food, according to Numerator.

Pet humanization. According to Numerator, 90% of United States dog households view their pets as members of the family. As pets are increasingly viewed as companions, friends and family members, pet owners are being transformed into "pet parents" who spare no expense for their loved ones, driving premiumization across pet categories. This trend is reflected in food purchasing decisions.

Increasing consumer focus on health & wellness. Consumers are increasingly purchasing fresh, natural and organic food products. We believe consumers are seeking simple, fresh and easy to understand food products from brands they trust and made with ingredients that are transparently sourced.

The pet food purchasing decision is underpinned by higher brand loyalty than many other consumer packaged goods categories. A consumer selecting a pet food brand resists frequent switching in order to avoid disrupting the pet's diet, resulting in high repeat purchasing behavior. As a result, we believe that as consumers try fresh, refrigerated pet food, they are likely to become repeat users of the product.
Freshpet has an opportunity to capture market share in this large and growing category by mainstreaming fresh food for pets and making fresh food a greater part of dogs' and cats' main meals.

Even though long-term consumer trends of pet humanization and health and wellness are well documented, conventional pet food sold as dry kibble or wet food in cans has not changed substantially for decades. We believe that the pet food industry has not kept pace with how consumers think about food for their families, including their pets. As a result, consumers are searching for higher quality, less processed food for their dogs' and cats' meals that measure up to today's sensibilities of what actually constitutes "good food." Freshpet addresses this growing need with affordable offerings accessible to the average consumer.
Our mission is to elevate the way we feed our pets with fresh food that nourishes all. And, we are committed to doing so in ways that are good for Pets, People, and Planet.

Our pets are members of our family and deserve to eat the kind of fresh, healthy food that we do. Freshpet's carefully selected ingredients and gentle cooking process ensures best-in-class bioavailable nutrition. Hundreds of customer testimonials each year underscore Freshpet's support of a long and healthy life. Further, since founding Freshpet, we have donated nearly twenty-six million fresh meals to pets via shelters, charitable organizations, and humane societies, including St Hubert's Animal Welfare Center, Pennsylvania SPCA, StrayDog Inc. and 4 Paws for Ability.

Our people include our team members, pet parents, and our partners. We treat our team members with respect and are committed to helping them develop professionally and personally. These efforts have contributed to an employee net promoter score of 7.9. Additionally, we strive to be good partners with customers, distributors, and suppliers by conducting business with honesty and transparency knowing that we cannot grow without their support.

We are committed to minimizing our environmental impact while providing the healthiest, tastiest pet food possible. All Freshpet Kitchens are landfill-free facilities thanks to our commitment to recycling, digesting, and waste-to-energy processes. We support renewable energy by matching the electricity used in Freshpet Kitchens and offices as well as our refrigerators in over 30,000 retail locations with Green-E Certified renewable energy certificates from North American based projects. Freshpet's chiller fleet efficiency continues to improve with our latest units using up to 91% less electricity than older units. 2023 saw the introduction of our Texas distribution center and freight bracket pricing program. These efforts helped minimize the fuel used to ship Freshpet products to our customers resulting in significantly reduced logistics costs and environmental footprints.

Our commitment to our values helps us engage with consumers, motivate our team members, and attract strong partners, which allows us to fulfill our mission of delivering the best nutritional product choices to improve the well-being of our pets, enrich pet parents' lives, and contribute to communities.

headings: Risks Related to our Growth Strategy and Need for Capital
We may not be able to successfully implement our growth strategy on a timely basis or at all.
We expect to need capital in the future for business development, and we may not be able to generate sufficient cash flow or raise capital on acceptable terms to meet our needs.
Loss of our key executive officers or personnel, or an inability to attract and retain such management and other personnel, could negatively affect our business.
Risks Related to Competition in Our Industry
The pet food product category in which we participate is highly competitive. If we are unable to compete effectively, our results of operations could be adversely affected.
Our operating results depend, in part, on the sufficiency and effectiveness of our marketing and trade spending programs.
Risks Related to our Products and Customers
Our business depends on our ability to introduce new products and improve existing products in anticipation of changes in consumer preferences and demographics.
If we fail to develop and maintain our brand, or the quality of our products that customers have come to expect, our business could suffer.
If we are unable to maintain or increase prices for our products, our results of operations may be adversely affected.
Risks Related to our Manufacturing and Supply Chain
Our manufacturing capacity and expansion plans could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition and results of operations.
If we do not manage our supply chain effectively, including inventory levels, our business, financial condition and results of operation may be adversely affected.
If the operating capacity or reputation of our Freshpet Fridges is harmed, our business, financial condition and results of operations may suffer.
If the ingredients we use in our products are contaminated, alleged to be contaminated or are otherwise rumored to have adverse effects, our results of operations could be adversely affected.
Outbreaks of animal diseases could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition and results of operations.
Failure by our transportation providers to deliver our products on time or at all could result in lost sales.
Disruptions in the U.S. and international economy may adversely affect our business, results of operations, and financial condition.
Our ability to meet our workforce needs, particularly for staffing our Freshpet Kitchens, is crucial
Risks Related to Government Regulation and Legal Proceedings
Government regulation, scrutiny, warnings and public perception could increase our costs of production and increase legal and regulatory expenses.
From time to time, we may be subject to litigation, government investigations or governmental proceedings, which may adversely impact our results of operations and financial condition.
Risks Related to Intellectual Property
If we are not successful in protecting our intellectual property rights, our business, financial conditions and results of operations may be harmed.
Risks Related to our International Operations
We may face difficulties as we expand into countries in which we have no prior operating experience.
Risks Related to Environmental Regulation and Environmental Risks
Risks Related to Information Technology and Cyber Security
Our business operations could be disrupted if our information technology systems fail to perform adequately.
We are subject to cyber security risks and may incur increasing costs in an effort to minimize those risks.
Our increasing use of artificial intelligence ("AI") technologies presents operations, legal, ethical and reputational risks that could adversely affect our business.
paragraphs: Investing in our common stock involves a high degree of risk. The following is a discussion of the risks, uncertainties and assumptions that we believe are material to our business, which should be considered in conjunction with the other information contained in this report, including our consolidated financial statements and accompanying notes. If any of the following risks actually occurs, our business, financial condition or results of operations could be materially adversely affected. While the risks are organized by headers, and each risk is discussed separately, many are interrelated. In any such case, the trading price of our common stock could decline, and you could lose all or part of your investment. Additional risks and uncertainties not currently known to us or that we currently deem to be immaterial also may materially adversely affect our business, financial condition, or results of operations.

Our future success depends, in large part, on our ability to implement our growth strategy by retaining existing customers, attracting new consumers to our brand, expanding distribution through the timely expansion of certain of our Freshpet Kitchens, the installation of new Freshpet Fridges, and launching new products. Our ability to increase awareness, consumer trial and adoption of our products, and to implement this growth strategy depends, among other things, on our ability to:
•implement our marketing strategy; •expand and maintain brand loyalty; •partner with customers to secure space for our Freshpet Fridges;
•develop new product lines and extensions; •partner with distributors to deliver our products to customers;
•continue to compete effectively in multiple classes of retail, including grocery, mass, international, digital, pet specialty, and club; and
•build capacity to meet consumer demand, including the timely expansion of certain of our Freshpet Kitchens.

Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations" in the Company's 2024 Annual Report on Form 10-K, which information is incorporated herein by reference.

Freshpet's mission is to elevate the way we feed our pets with fresh food that nourishes all. We were inspired by the rapidly growing view among pet owners that their dogs and cats are a part of their family, leading them to demand healthier pet food choices. Since Freshpet's inception in 2006, we have created a comprehensive business model to deliver wholesome pet food that pet parents can trust, and in the process, we believe we have become one of the fastest growing pet food companies in North America. Our business model is difficult for others to replicate and we see significant opportunity for future growth by leveraging the unique elements of our business, including our brand, our product know-how, our Freshpet Kitchens, our refrigerated distribution, our Freshpet Fridges and our culture.

Our net sales are derived from the sale of fresh pet food products to retailers, through direct sales and distributor arrangements. Our products are primarily sold to consumers through a fast-growing network of company-owned branded refrigerators, known as Freshpet Fridges, located in our customers' stores. We continue to roll out Freshpet Fridges at leading retailers across North America and parts of Europe and have installed Freshpet Fridges in approximately 30,235 retail stores as of December 31, 2025. Our products are sold under the Freshpet brand name with ingredients, packaging and labeling customized by class of retail. Sales are recorded net of discounts, returns and promotional allowances.
Our net sales growth strategy is driven by the following key factors:

•Increasing sales velocity from the average Freshpet Fridge due to increasing awareness, trial and adoption of Freshpet products and innovation. Our investments in marketing and advertising help to drive awareness and trial at each point of sale.

•Increasing distribution and penetration of Freshpet products in major classes of retail, including Grocery, Mass, International, Digital, Pet Specialty, and Club. The impact of new Freshpet Fridge installations on our net sales varies by retail class and depends on numerous factors including store traffic, refrigerator size, placement within the store, and proximity to other stores that carry our products. Digital orders include any purchases made online, including our direct-to-consumer business, and may also be fulfilled by our Freshpet Fridge network in brick and mortar stores.
•Consumer trends including long-term growth in pet ownership, pet humanization and a focus on health and wellness.
•At times we increase our sales price to offset any adverse movement in input costs.

Our gross profit is net of costs of goods sold, which include the costs of product manufacturing, product ingredients, packaging materials and inbound freight, as well as depreciation and amortization and non-cash share-based compensation.
We expect to continue to mitigate any adverse movement in input costs through a combination of cost management and price increases.
Our selling, general and administrative expenses consist of the following:
Outbound freight. We use a third-party logistics provider for outbound freight that ships directly to retailers as well as third-party distributors.

Marketing & advertising. Our marketing and advertising expenses primarily consist of television advertising, digital, and social media channels. Our digital efforts span a range of platforms and environments, including company and retail websites, retail media networks, search engines, blogs, and online reviews. These expenses may vary from quarter to quarter depending on the timing of marketing and advertising campaigns.

paragraphs: Freshpet, Inc. ("Freshpet," the "Company," "we" or "our") 正在透過引導消費者重新評估過去數十年來幾乎未變的傳統狗貓糧產品，來顛覆超過 560 億美元的美國寵物食品產業。我們的品牌定位能從日益成長的寵物人化以及消費者對健康與 wellness 的關注趨勢中獲益。我們以平均消費者可負擔的價格來銷售產品，使我們擁有廣泛的族羣吸引力，並能打入多種零售類別，包括超商、量販、國際市場、數位通路、寵物專賣與俱樂部。我們已成功擴展 Freshpet Fridges 的通路網路至領導的藍籌零售連鎖品牌。我們商業模式的強項也延伸至我們的客戶，我們認為客戶發現 Freshpet 能提升他們的寵物類別銷售、提高人潮、增加顧客造訪頻率並提供業界領先的毛利率。截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，我們在美國的戶數滲透率約為 1520 萬戶。此外，我們認為有機會擴展我們的網路至國際市場，如我們在英國市場的行動所示。
我們主要競爭的市場為美國的狗貓糧市場。寵物食品市場歷來具有強韌性，因為消費者即使在經濟衰退期間仍持續在寵物身上支出，我們認為北美地區的寵物食品支出將長期增加。
我們認為以下趨勢將推動我們產業的成長：
寵物飼養。根據 Numerator，美國目前約有 9800 萬戶購買狗或貓糧的戶數，意味著約 73% 的總戶數購買狗和/或貓糧。
寵物人化。根據 Numerator，約 90% 的美國狗飼養戶將他們的寵物視為家庭的一員。隨著寵物被視為伴侶、朋友和家庭成員，飼養者正轉變為 "寵物父母"，他們願意為所愛的寵物不計代價，推動寵物類別的高價化。這種趨勢反映在食品的購買決策上。
消費者對健康與 wellness 的關注日益增加。消費者越來越傾向購買新鮮、天然和有機的食品產品。我們認為消費者正在尋求簡單、新鮮且容易理解的食品產品，來自他們信任的品牌，並使用來源透明的原料。
寵物食品的購買決策受到比許多其他消費性包裝商品類別更高的品牌忠誠度支撐。消費者在選擇寵物食品品牌時，會抗拒頻繁更換以避免幹擾寵物的飲食，導致高頻率的重複購買行為。因此，我們認為當消費者嘗試新鮮、冷藏的寵物食品時，他們很可能是該產品的重複使用者。
Freshpet 有機會在這個龐大且成長中的類別中佔據市場份額，透過將新鮮食品推廣至寵物，並使新鮮食品成為狗和貓主餐的一部分。
儘管長期來看，寵物人性化與健康與 wellness 的消費趨勢已廣為記錄，但傳統的寵物食品，如乾糧或罐頭食品，數十年來並未有顯著改變。我們認為，寵物食品產業未能跟上消費者對家庭成員，包括寵物，所認為的食品觀念。因此，消費者正在尋找更高品質、較少加工的食品，以符合當前對 "好食品" 的標準。Freshpet 透過可負擔的產品，回應這日益增長的需求，使平均消費者都能接觸到。
我們的使命是提升我們餵養寵物的方式，以新鮮食品提供營養。我們致力於以對寵物、人類和地球有益的方式來實現這個目標。

我們的寵物是我們家庭的一員，他們應享有與我們一樣的新鮮、健康的食品。Freshpet 精心挑選的原料與溫和的烹調過程，確保了最佳的生物可利用性營養。每年數百則客戶的證詞都強調 Freshpet 對延長且健康生活的支持。此外，自創立 Freshpet 以來，我們已捐贈近二千六百萬份新鮮餐點給寵物，透過收容所、慈善機構與人道協會，包括 St Hubert's Animal Welfare Center、Pennsylvania SPCA、StrayDog Inc. 和 4 Paws for Ability。
我們的團隊包括我們的員工、寵物家長與合作夥伴。我們以尊重對待員工，並致力於協助他們在專業與個人層面進行發展。這些努力已促成員工淨推薦指數為 7.9。此外，我們努力成為與客戶、經銷商與供應商良好的合作夥伴，透過誠實與透明的商業作風進行業務，我們知道沒有他們的支持，我們無法成長。

我們致力於減少對環境的影響，同時提供最健康、最美味的寵物食品。所有 Freshpet 廠區均為無垃圾掩埋場設施，感謝我們對回收、厭氧消化與廢棄物轉能源流程的承諾。我們支持可再生能源，透過匹配 Freshpet 廠區與辦公室以及超過 30,000 個零售點的冷氣機所使用的電力，與北美洲基於的 Green-E 認證可再生能源憑證。Freshpet 的冷氣機隊效率持續改善，我們最新的機種使用電力較舊機種減少達 91%。2023 年我們推出了德克薩斯州的配送中心與貨運分級定價計畫。這些努力有助於減少將 Freshpet 產品運送到客戶所使用的燃料，從而大幅降低物流成本與環境足跡。
我們對價值的承諾幫助我們與消費者互動、激勵我們的員工，並吸引強大的合作夥伴，這使我們能實現我們的使命，即提供最佳的營養產品選擇，以改善我們寵物的健康狀況，豐富寵物家長的生活，並為社區做出貢獻。

paragraphs: 以下討論包含前瞻性陳述，涉及風險與不確定性。我們的實際結果可能與這些前瞻性陳述所討論的情況有重大差異，這是因為多種因素，包括那些在「風險因素」中列舉的內容。以下關於我們財務狀況與營運成果的討論應與我們包含於本報告其他處的合併財務報表一併閱讀。
如需更多有關我們合併結果及流動性與資本資源於2024年12月31日結算年度與2023年12月31日結算年度比較之資訊，請參閱本公司2024年度報告表10-K中「第二部分，第七項 管理層對財務狀況與營運成果之分析」，此資訊已於 herein 予以引用。

Freshpet 的使命是提升我們餵養寵物的方式，以新鮮食物來營養所有寵物。我們受到寵物飼主日益增長的觀點所啟發，他們認為狗和貓是他們家庭的一部分，因此他們要求更健康的寵物飼料選擇。自Freshpet於2006年成立以來，我們已經建立了一個完整的商業模式，以提供寵物飼主可以信任的健康寵物飼料，而在這個過程中，我們相信我們已經成為北美地區成長最快的寵物飼料公司之一。我們的商業模式對他人來說很難複製，我們看到未來成長的顯著機會，透過我們業務的獨特元素，包括我們的品牌、我們的產品知識、我們的Freshpet廚房、我們的冷藏配送、我們的Freshpet冰箱以及我們的文化。

我們的淨銷售額來自向零售商銷售新鮮寵物飼料產品，透過直接銷售與經銷商安排。我們的產品主要透過一個快速成長的公司自有品牌冷藏冰箱網路銷售給消費者，這些冰箱稱為Freshpet冰箱，位於我們客戶的商店內。我們持續在北美及歐洲部分地區的領導零售商中佈設Freshpet冰箱，截至2025年12月31日，我們已安裝約30,235間零售商店的Freshpet冰箱。我們的產品以Freshpet品牌銷售，其成分、包裝與標籤會根據零售類別進行客製化。銷售金額已扣除折扣、退貨與促銷允許。
我們的淨銷售額成長策略是由以下關鍵因素所驅動：
•提高平均Freshpet冰箱的銷售速度，由於對Freshpet產品的認知度、試用與採用率提高以及創新。我們在行銷與廣告上的投資有助於在每個銷售點提高認知度與試用率。
•提高Freshpet產品在主要零售類別的分佈與滲透率，包括雜貨、大賣場、國際、數位、寵物專賣與俱樂部。新設Freshpet冰箱對我們淨銷售額的影響因零售類別而異，並取決於多種因素，包括商店人流量、冰箱大小、在商店內的擺放位置以及與其他銷售我們產品的商店的距離。數位訂單包括任何線上購買，包括我們的直接對消費者業務，也可能由我們的Freshpet冰箱網路在實體商店內完成。
•消費者趨勢，包括長期寵物飼養人數成長、寵物人性化以及對健康與 wellness 的關注。
• 有時我們會提高銷售價格以彌補任何輸入成本的不利變動。
我們的毛利是扣除商品銷售成本後的金額，商品銷售成本包括產品製造成本、產品原料、包裝材料及進口運費，以及折舊及攤銷費用與非現金股票基於薪酬。
我們預期會透過成本管理與價格提高的組合方式，持續彌補任何輸入成本的不利變動。
我們的營銷、一般及行政費用包含以下項目：
出貨運費。我們使用第三方物流供應商處理出貨運費，該供應商直接將貨物運送到零售商以及第三方經銷商。
行銷及廣告。我們的行銷及廣告費用主要包含電視廣告、數位廣告以及社交媒體渠道。我們的數位行銷活動涵蓋多種平台與環境，包括本公司及零售網站、零售媒體網路、搜尋引擎、部落格以及線上評論。這些費用可能根據行銷及廣告活動的時程而有所變動。

headings: 與我們成長策略及資金需求相關之風險
我們可能無法按時或完全成功執行我們的成長策略。
我們預期未來需要資金用於業務發展，我們可能無法產生足夠的現金流或在可接受的條件下籌集資金以滿足需求。
若失去我們的關鍵高階主管或員工，或無法吸引並留住這些管理及其它員工，可能會對我們的業務產生負面影響。
與我們產業中競爭相關之風險
我們參與的寵物食品產品類別競爭非常激烈。若我們無法有效競爭，我們的營運結果可能會受到不利影響。
我們的營運結果部分取決於我們行銷及貿易支出計畫的充足性與有效性。
與我們產品及客戶相關之風險
本公司業務取決於我們能否預見消費者偏好與人口結構的變化，並推出新產品或改善現有產品。
若我們未能發展並維持品牌，或無法維持客戶所期待的產品品質，本公司業務可能會受到影響。
若我們無法維持或提高產品價格，本公司營運成果可能會受到不利影響。
與製造與供應鏈相關之風險
本公司製造能力與擴張計畫可能對本公司業務、財務狀況及營運成果造成重大不利影響。
若我們無法有效管理供應鏈，包括存貨水準，本公司業務、財務狀況及營運成果可能會受到不利影響。
若本公司 Freshpet Fridges 的運作能力或聲譽受到損害，本公司業務、財務狀況及營運成果可能會受到影響。
若我們產品所使用之原料被污染、被指控污染或被 rumours 傳聞具有不利影響，本公司營運成果可能會受到不利影響。
動物疾病爆發可能對本公司的業務、財務狀況及營運成果造成重大不利影響。
若我方運輸合作夥伴未能及時或完全交付產品，可能導致銷售損失。
美國及國際經濟動盪可能對本公司業務、營運成果及財務狀況產生不利影響。
本公司滿足人力需求的能力，特別是為Freshpet Kitchens進行人手配置，至關重要。
與政府監管及法律程序相關的風險
政府監管、審查、警告及公眾觀感可能增加我方生產成本，並提高法律及監管費用。
有時，本公司可能面臨訴訟、政府調查或政府程序，可能對營運成果及財務狀況產生不利影響。
與智慧財產權相關的風險
若我們未能成功保護我們的智慧財產權權利，將可能對本公司業務、財務狀況及營運成果造成損害。
與國際業務相關的風險
我們在擴展至無先前營運經驗國家時，可能面臨困難。
與環境法規及環境風險相關的風險
與資訊科技及網路安全相關的風險
若資訊科技系統無法充分運作，將可能幹擾本公司業務運作。
本公司面臨網路安全風險，並可能因應降低這些風險而產生增加的成本。
本公司日益增加使用人工智慧（"AI"）技術，可能帶來營運、法律、倫理及聲譽風險，這些風險可能對本公司業務造成不利影響。
paragraphs: 投資本公司的普通股涉及高度風險。以下為有關風險、不確定性與假設的討論，我們認為這些內容對本公司業務具有重大影響，應與本報告中其他資訊一併考量，包括本公司合併財務報表及其附註。若任何上述風險實際發生，將可能對本公司業務、財務狀況或營運成果造成重大不利影響。雖然風險已按標題分類，且每項風險皆獨立討論，但許多風險彼此相關。在任何情況下，本公司普通股的交易價格可能下跌，您可能損失全部或部分投資。此外，尚有其他風險與不確定性，目前尚未為本公司所知或目前認為不重要，也可能對本公司業務、財務狀況或營運成果造成重大不利影響。
本公司未來的成功，在很大程度上取決於我們能否透過維持現有客戶、吸引新消費者認同本公司品牌、透過及時擴展部分Freshpet Kitchens、安裝新Freshpet Fridges以及推出新產品來執行成長策略。我們能否提高產品知名度、消費者試用與採用率，並執行此成長策略，取決於多項因素，包括我們能否：
•執行本公司行銷策略； •擴展並維持品牌忠誠度； •與客戶合作以取得Freshpet Fridges的空間；
•開發新產品線與延伸產品； •與經銷商合作以將產品送達客戶；
•持續在多種零售類別中有效競爭，包括雜貨、大眾商品、國際、數位、寵物專賣與俱樂部；以及
•建立應對消費者需求的生產能力，包括及時擴展部分Freshpet Kitchens。
